data.name: Awhad
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘awhada’, meaning 'to repeat' or 'to echo'. This name is mentioned in the Quran in reference to the Prophet's night journey (Isra and Mi'raj) and his encounter with different prophets and messengers. It symbolizes continuity, consistency, and repetition in the divine message.

in_english.name: Awhad
in_english.meaning: Unique, one and only, singular, unmatched
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'w-h-d', which conveys the meaning of unity, oneness, and singularity. In Islamic tradition, Awhad is an attribute of Allah, signifying His uniqueness and oneness. The name is mentioned in the Quran (3:18), emphasizing the unity of God. Awhad symbolizes the divine attribute of being the only one, unmatched and unparalleled.

This etymology can be linked to Awhad's significance as a personal name, reflecting a consistent and repeated pattern in life, embodying the values of endurance, resilience, and persistence.
